# Permintaan AI terus kukuh, BIMB Securities jangka ViTrox catat prestasi terbaik suku keempat 2026

 

Oleh SARAH NADLIN ROHIM

editor@dagangnews.com

KUALA LUMPUR 6 Nov - Permintaan terhadap teknologi kecerdasan buatan (AI) yang terus meningkat dijangka memacu ViTrox Corporation Berhad mencatat prestasi suku tahunan paling kukuh bagi tahun kewangan 2026, disokong peningkatan tempahan dan penghantaran mesin pemeriksaan semikonduktor.

BIMB Securities Research berkata, prospek pertumbuhan ViTrox kekal positif berikutan tiada petunjuk jelas bahawa syarikat teknologi utama dunia akan memperlahankan perbelanjaan berkaitan AI, sekali gus menyokong permintaan terhadap peralatan pemeriksaan elektronik syarikat itu.

Menurut firma penyelidikan berkenaan, aliran tempahan yang kukuh dijangka meningkatkan penghantaran mesin dan hasil ViTrox pada suku keempat 2026, dengan potensi keuntungan lebih tinggi sekiranya penghantaran dapat dilaksanakan lebih awal daripada jangkaan.

Prestasi itu turut disokong keputusan kewangan suku ketiga berakhir 30 September 2026 yang menyaksikan hasil ViTrox melonjak 112.2% kepada RM485.1 juta berbanding RM228.6 juta setahun sebelumnya, sekali gus melepasi sasaran tertinggi RM400 juta yang ditetapkan pengurusan.

Keuntungan bersih teras syarikat pula melonjak 287.8% kepada RM118.7 juta, dipacu permintaan tinggi terhadap mesin pemeriksaan papan elektronik automatik (ABI) dan sistem pemeriksaan penglihatan mesin (MVS), selain peningkatan margin keuntungan kepada 24.5% daripada 13.4% sebelumnya.

Bagi sembilan bulan pertama 2026, ViTrox merekodkan keuntungan bersih teras RM254.1 juta, meningkat 193.7% berbanding tempoh sama tahun lalu, sekali gus mengatasi jangkaan BIMB Securities dan konsensus pasaran.

Susulan prestasi kukuh itu, BIMB Securities menaikkan unjuran keuntungan ViTrox bagi tahun kewangan 2026 hingga 2028 antara 13.7% hingga 17.1%, dengan keuntungan bersih teras dijangka mencecah RM368.4 juta pada 2026 dan meningkat kepada RM448.3 juta pada 2027.

Firma penyelidikan itu turut menaikkan saranan saham ViTrox kepada 'beli' dengan harga sasaran RM11.80 berbanding RM10.30 sebelum ini, mencerminkan potensi kenaikan 11.4% daripada harga rujukan RM10.60, didorong prospek permintaan AI yang berterusan serta peluang peningkatan keuntungan.- DagangNews.com

# ViTrox Q3 FY2026 Net Profit Triples to RM118.6 Million on Record RM485.1 Million Revenue

Posted on November 5, 2026 at 5:50 pm (GMT+8)

 

ViTrox Corporation Berhad (Bursa: VITROX, 0097) reported a record quarterly performance, with third-quarter FY2026 revenue surging 112.2% year-on-year to RM485.1 million and net profit attributable to owners rising 241.6% to RM118.6 million. The results, announced on 5 November 2026 for the financial period ended 30 September 2026, were driven by strong demand for AI infrastructure and networking equipment inspection solutions across its Automated Board Inspection (ABI) and Machine Vision System (MVS) segments.

## Financial Highlights

| Metric (RM’000 unless stated) | Q3 FY2026 | Q3 FY2025 | Change | 9M FY2026 | 9M FY2025 | Change |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Revenue | 485,101 | 228,567 | +112.2% | 1,127,067 | 552,728 | +103.9% |
| Profit before tax | 136,774 | 50,464 | +171.0% | 298,379 | 115,784 | +157.7% |
| Net profit attributable to owners | 118,580 | 34,716 | +241.6% | 254,821 | 87,009 | +192.9% |
| Basic EPS (sen) | 6.26 | 1.83 | +242.1% | 13.45 | 4.60 | +192.4% |
| PBT margin | ~28.2% | ~22.1% | +6.1 pp | ~26.5% | ~20.9% | +5.6 pp |
| Dividend per share (sen) | 0.00 | 1.18 | n.m. | 0.70 | n.a. | n.a. |

Note: PBT margin computed from disclosed figures. 9M FY2026 dividend per share reflects dividends declared for the period. Q3 FY2025 comparative dividend of 1.18 sen was a final dividend for FY2025 paid in July 2026. No dividend was declared in Q3 FY2026.

On a sequential basis, revenue rose 29.4% from RM374.9 million in Q2 FY2026, while profit before tax grew 36.8% to RM136.8 million. Net profit attributable to owners increased 39.4% quarter-on-quarter to RM118.6 million.

The company said growth was primarily driven by strong demand across its ABI and MVS segments, supported by expanded adoption of advanced inspection solutions for AI infrastructure and networking equipment. Manufacturing economies of scale and a favourable product mix lifted PBT, while a lower effective tax rate—due to tax incentives enjoyed by wholly-owned subsidiary ViTrox Technologies Sdn Bhd (VTSB)—boosted net profit. VTSB holds a five-year income tax exemption, extendable for a further five years, for activities related to 4D advanced industrial automation systems for semiconductor advanced packaging and AI smart factories.

### Cash Flow and Balance Sheet

Despite the strong profit, the group reported net cash used in operating activities of RM8.5 million for 9M FY2026, compared with net cash from operating activities of RM101.5 million a year earlier. Operating profit before working capital changes rose to RM305.5 million from RM122.4 million, but working capital absorbed cash as inventories increased by RM231.8 million and receivables rose by RM304.1 million. Capital expenditure on property, plant and equipment amounted to RM63.6 million versus RM23.2 million previously. Cash and cash equivalents declined to RM283.9 million at 30 September 2026 from RM409.2 million at 31 December 2025.

Total term loans stood at RM77.1 million (USD18.9 million) at end-September 2026, down from RM101.7 million (USD24.1 million) a year earlier. The higher prior-year balance reflected an additional term loan drawn to finance construction of Campus 3.0 in Batu Kawan. Effective interest rates for term loans ranged from 4.77% to 4.83%, compared with 5.19% to 5.34% previously. Net assets per share rose to RM0.7230 from RM0.5981 at 31 December 2025.

### Dividends

No dividend was proposed or declared in the current quarter. During the nine-month period, the company paid an interim tax-exempt dividend of 0.63 sen per share (RM11.9 million) for FY2025 on 16 January 2026 and a final tax-exempt dividend of 1.18 sen per share (RM22.4 million) for FY2025 on 15 July 2026. Total dividends paid in 9M FY2026 amounted to RM34.3 million versus RM22.7 million a year earlier.

### Outlook

ViTrox anticipates a favourable business environment for the remainder of FY2026 and into 2027, citing hyperscaler spending projected at US$754 billion in 2026 and US$1.11 trillion in 2027. Gartner forecasts worldwide semiconductor revenue to grow 92% to US$1.6 trillion in 2026 and reach US$1.9 trillion in 2027, while SEMI projects global semiconductor equipment sales of US$165.9 billion in 2026, up 23.2%. The group continues to position its advanced packaging and high-precision inspection solutions for AI accelerators and High Bandwidth Memory, and is developing next-generation high-resolution machine vision solutions.

The company flagged risks from foreign exchange volatility and geopolitical uncertainties, and noted that its operations are dependent on the cyclical semiconductor and electronics industries. It said it will maintain prudent cost management and operational discipline.

# Permintaan AI terus kukuh, BIMB Securities jangka ViTrox catat prestasi terbaik suku keempat 2026

 

Oleh SARAH NADLIN ROHIM

editor@dagangnews.com

KUALA LUMPUR 6 Nov - Permintaan terhadap teknologi kecerdasan buatan (AI) yang terus meningkat dijangka memacu ViTrox Corporation Berhad mencatat prestasi suku tahunan paling kukuh bagi tahun kewangan 2026, disokong peningkatan tempahan dan penghantaran mesin pemeriksaan semikonduktor.

BIMB Securities Research berkata, prospek pertumbuhan ViTrox kekal positif berikutan tiada petunjuk jelas bahawa syarikat teknologi utama dunia akan memperlahankan perbelanjaan berkaitan AI, sekali gus menyokong permintaan terhadap peralatan pemeriksaan elektronik syarikat itu.

Menurut firma penyelidikan berkenaan, aliran tempahan yang kukuh dijangka meningkatkan penghantaran mesin dan hasil ViTrox pada suku keempat 2026, dengan potensi keuntungan lebih tinggi sekiranya penghantaran dapat dilaksanakan lebih awal daripada jangkaan.

Prestasi itu turut disokong keputusan kewangan suku ketiga berakhir 30 September 2026 yang menyaksikan hasil ViTrox melonjak 112.2% kepada RM485.1 juta berbanding RM228.6 juta setahun sebelumnya, sekali gus melepasi sasaran tertinggi RM400 juta yang ditetapkan pengurusan.

Keuntungan bersih teras syarikat pula melonjak 287.8% kepada RM118.7 juta, dipacu permintaan tinggi terhadap mesin pemeriksaan papan elektronik automatik (ABI) dan sistem pemeriksaan penglihatan mesin (MVS), selain peningkatan margin keuntungan kepada 24.5% daripada 13.4% sebelumnya.

Bagi sembilan bulan pertama 2026, ViTrox merekodkan keuntungan bersih teras RM254.1 juta, meningkat 193.7% berbanding tempoh sama tahun lalu, sekali gus mengatasi jangkaan BIMB Securities dan konsensus pasaran.

Susulan prestasi kukuh itu, BIMB Securities menaikkan unjuran keuntungan ViTrox bagi tahun kewangan 2026 hingga 2028 antara 13.7% hingga 17.1%, dengan keuntungan bersih teras dijangka mencecah RM368.4 juta pada 2026 dan meningkat kepada RM448.3 juta pada 2027.

Firma penyelidikan itu turut menaikkan saranan saham ViTrox kepada 'beli' dengan harga sasaran RM11.80 berbanding RM10.30 sebelum ini, mencerminkan potensi kenaikan 11.4% daripada harga rujukan RM10.60, didorong prospek permintaan AI yang berterusan serta peluang peningkatan keuntungan.- DagangNews.com

# ViTrox Q3 FY2026 Net Profit Triples to RM118.6 Million on Record RM485.1 Million Revenue

Posted on November 5, 2026 at 5:50 pm (GMT+8)

 

ViTrox Corporation Berhad (Bursa: VITROX, 0097) reported a record quarterly performance, with third-quarter FY2026 revenue surging 112.2% year-on-year to RM485.1 million and net profit attributable to owners rising 241.6% to RM118.6 million. The results, announced on 5 November 2026 for the financial period ended 30 September 2026, were driven by strong demand for AI infrastructure and networking equipment inspection solutions across its Automated Board Inspection (ABI) and Machine Vision System (MVS) segments.

## Financial Highlights
